page.notes: The Greek word after "definierat" is printed as a compressed form; the reading προωρισεν is uncertain. The marginal mark at the left beside "Act.iv" is a stray sign and was not transcribed. The catchword at the foot is partly hidden and is read as "quol-" with some doubt. The § at the end of the last line is copied as printed.
